purpose: Existing AWS RDS V30, real HTTP coupon comparison; one application, pool 10. No offered RPS target is an accomplishment by itself.

checks: no counter update in unit variants

capacityExploration.interpretation: Short probes select a bracket, not a sustained capacity claim. Additional bracket/refinement rates recorded before execution.
capacityExploration.stopReason: Avoid sending higher overload once a boundary is bracketed; repeat the same ascending ladder in another rotated cohort.

sustainedConfirmation.rates: Select common boundary rates after probes; document selection before execution.

additionalScenarios: other campaign preparation during active issuance

comparability.poolIsolation: RR for db and RR variants; RC for RC variants
comparability.warmup: Separate fixture, 100 RPS for 10 seconds before each measured trial.
comparability.dataset: Same existing RDS; campaign history grows, owned benchmark fixtures are closed and retained.

acceptance.latencyAdvantageClaim: Paired five repetitions; at least 20% and 5 ms lower p95 in at least four, with no correctness/p99 regression. Otherwise no demonstrated winner.

observation.httpWindow: First request start to last response completion; generator full 1-second intervals and app samples within this window.
observation.rdsCpu: Only full 60-second CloudWatch buckets inside actual HTTP window. No per-probe CPU claim for 20 seconds.
observation.database: Read-only separate JDBC observer, one connection, 2-second samples, statement aggregates every fifth sample.
stopConditions: RDS CPU credits <20 or positive surplus; retain and reassess
